title: अंश ५ · अध्याय ३७

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
एवं दैत्यवधं कृष्णो बलदेव सहायवान् ।
चक्रे दुष्टक्षितीशानां तथैव जगतः कृते ॥ १ ॥
items.tr:
evaṃ daityavadhaṃ kṛṣṇo baladeva sahāyavān |
cakre duṣṭakṣitīśānāṃ tathaiva jagataḥ kṛte || 1 ||

items.text:
क्षितेश्च भारं भगवान्फाल्गुनेन समन्वितः ।
आवतारयामास विभुस्समस्ताक्षोहिणी वधात् ॥ २ ॥
items.tr:
kṣiteśca bhāraṃ bhagavānphālgunena samanvitaḥ |
āvatārayāmāsa vibhussamastākṣohiṇī vadhāt || 2 ||

items.text:
कृत्वा भारावतरणं भुवो हत्वाऽखिलान्नृपान् ।
शापव्याजेन विप्राणामुपसंहृतवान्कुलम् ॥ ३ ॥
items.tr:
kṛtvā bhārāvataraṇaṃ bhuvo hatvā'khilānnṛpān |
śāpavyājena viprāṇāmupasaṃhṛtavānkulam || 3 ||

items.text:
उत्सृज्य द्वारकां कृष्णस्त्यक्त्वा मानुष्यमात्मनः ।
सांशो विष्णुमयं स्थानं प्रविवेश मुने निजम् ॥ ४ ॥
items.tr:
utsṛjya dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇastyaktvā mānuṣyamātmanaḥ |
sāṃśo viṣṇumayaṃ sthānaṃ praviveśa mune nijam || 4 ||

items.speaker: मैत्रेय उवाच
items.text:
स विप्रशापव्याजेन संजह्रे स्वकुलं कथम् ।
कथं च मानुषं देहमुत्ससर्ज जनार्दनः ॥ ५ ॥
items.tr:
sa vipraśāpavyājena saṃjahre svakulaṃ katham |
kathaṃ ca mānuṣaṃ dehamutsasarja janārdanaḥ || 5 ||

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
विश्वामित्रस्तथा कण्वो नारदश्च महामुनिः ।
पिंडारके महातीर्थे दृष्ट्वा यदुकुमारकैः ॥ ६ ॥
items.tr:
viśvāmitrastathā kaṇvo nāradaśca mahāmuniḥ |
piṃḍārake mahātīrthe dṛṣṭvā yadukumārakaiḥ || 6 ||

items.text:
ततस्ते यौवनोन्मत्ता भाविकार्यप्रचोदिताः ।
सांबं जांबवतीपुत्रं भूषयित्वा स्त्रियं यथा ॥ ७ ॥
items.tr:
tataste yauvanonmattā bhāvikāryapracoditāḥ |
sāṃbaṃ jāṃbavatīputraṃ bhūṣayitvā striyaṃ yathā || 7 ||

items.text:
प्रश्रितास्तान्मुनीनूचुः प्रणिपातपुरस्सरम् ।
इयं स्त्री पुत्रकामा वै ब्रूत किं जनयिष्यति ॥ ८ ॥
items.tr:
praśritāstānmunīnūcuḥ praṇipātapurassaram |
iyaṃ strī putrakāmā vai brūta kiṃ janayiṣyati || 8 ||

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
दिव्यज्ञानोपपन्नास्ते विप्रलब्धाः कुमारकैः ।
मुनयः कुपिताः प्रोचुर्मुसलं जनयिष्यति ॥ ९ ॥
items.tr:
divyajñānopapannāste vipralabdhāḥ kumārakaiḥ |
munayaḥ kupitāḥ procurmusalaṃ janayiṣyati || 9 ||

items.text:
सर्वयादवसंहारकारणं भुवनोत्तरम् ।
येनाखिलकुलोत्सादो यादवानां भविष्यति ॥ १० ॥
items.tr:
sarvayādavasaṃhārakāraṇaṃ bhuvanottaram |
yenākhilakulotsādo yādavānāṃ bhaviṣyati || 10 ||

items.text:
इत्युक्तास्ते कुमारास्तु आचचक्षुर्यथातथम् ।
उग्रसेनाय मुसलं जज्ञे सांबस्य चोदरात् ॥ ११ ॥
items.tr:
ityuktāste kumārāstu ācacakṣuryathātatham |
ugrasenāya musalaṃ jajñe sāṃbasya codarāt || 11 ||

items.text:
तदुग्रसेनो मुसलमयश्चूर्णमकारयत् ।
जज्ञे तदेरकाचूर्णं प्रक्षिप्तं तैर्महोदधौ ॥ १२ ॥
items.tr:
tadugraseno musalamayaścūrṇamakārayat |
jajñe taderakācūrṇaṃ prakṣiptaṃ tairmahodadhau || 12 ||

items.text:
मुसलस्याथ लोहस्य चूर्णितस्य तु यादवैः ।
खंडं चूर्णितशेषं तु ततो यत्तोमराकृति ॥ १३ ॥
items.tr:
musalasyātha lohasya cūrṇitasya tu yādavaiḥ |
khaṃḍaṃ cūrṇitaśeṣaṃ tu tato yattomarākṛti || 13 ||

items.text:
तदप्यंबुनिधौ क्षिप्तं मत्स्यो जग्राह जालिभिः ।
घातितस्योदरात्तस्य लुब्धो जग्राह तज्जराः ॥ १४ ॥
items.tr:
tadapyaṃbunidhau kṣiptaṃ matsyo jagrāha jālibhiḥ |
ghātitasyodarāttasya lubdho jagrāha tajjarāḥ || 14 ||

items.text:
विज्ञातपरमार्थोपि भगवान्मधुसूदनः ।
नैच्छत्तदन्यथा कर्त्तुं विधिना यत्समीहितम् ॥ १५ ॥
items.tr:
vijñātaparamārthopi bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ |
naicchattadanyathā karttuṃ vidhinā yatsamīhitam || 15 ||

items.text:
देवैश्च प्रहितो वायुः प्रणिपत्त्याह केशवम् ।
रहस्येवमहं दूतः प्रहितो भगवन्सुरैः ॥ १६ ॥
items.tr:
devaiśca prahito vāyuḥ praṇipattyāha keśavam |
rahasyevamahaṃ dūtaḥ prahito bhagavansuraiḥ || 16 ||

items.text:
वस्वश्विमरुदादित्यरुद्र साध्यादिभिस्सह ।
विज्ञापयति शक्रस्त्वां तदिदं श्रूयतां विभो ॥ १७ ॥
items.tr:
vasvaśvimarudādityarudra sādhyādibhissaha |
vijñāpayati śakrastvāṃ tadidaṃ śrūyatāṃ vibho || 17 ||

items.text:
भारावतरणार्थाय वर्षाणामधिकं शतम् ।
भगवानवतीर्णोत्र त्रिदशैस्सह चोदितः ॥ १८ ॥
items.tr:
bhārāvataraṇārthāya varṣāṇāmadhikaṃ śatam |
bhagavānavatīrṇotra tridaśaissaha coditaḥ || 18 ||

items.text:
दुर्वृत्ता निहता दैत्या भुवो भारोऽवतारितः ।
त्वया मनाथास्त्रिदशा भवंतु त्रिदिवे सदा ॥ १९ ॥
items.tr:
durvṛttā nihatā daityā bhuvo bhāro'vatāritaḥ |
tvayā manāthāstridaśā bhavaṃtu tridive sadā || 19 ||

items.text:
तदतीतं जगन्नाथ वर्षाणामधिकं शतम् ।
इदानीं गम्यतां स्वर्गो भवता यदि रोचते ॥ २० ॥
items.tr:
tadatītaṃ jagannātha varṣāṇāmadhikaṃ śatam |
idānīṃ gamyatāṃ svargo bhavatā yadi rocate || 20 ||

items.text:
देवैर्विज्ञाप्यते देव तथात्रैव रतिस्तव ।
तत्स्थीयतां यथाकालमास्थेयमनुजीविभिः ॥ २१ ॥
items.tr:
devairvijñāpyate deva tathātraiva ratistava |
tatsthīyatāṃ yathākālamāstheyamanujīvibhiḥ || 21 ||

items.text:
यत्त्वमात्थाखिलं दूत वेद्म्येतदहमप्युत ।
प्रारब्ध एव हि मया यादवानां परिक्षयः ॥ २२ ॥
items.tr:
yattvamātthākhilaṃ dūta vedmyetadahamapyuta |
prārabdha eva hi mayā yādavānāṃ parikṣayaḥ || 22 ||
items.speaker: श्रीभगवानुवाच

items.text:
भुवो नाद्यापि भारोऽयं यादवैरनिबर्हितैः ।
अवतार्य करोम्येतत्सप्तरात्रेण सत्वरः ॥ २३ ॥
items.tr:
bhuvo nādyāpi bhāro'yaṃ yādavairanibarhitaiḥ |
avatārya karomyetatsaptarātreṇa satvaraḥ || 23 ||

items.text:
यथा गृहीतमंभोधेर्दत्त्वाहं द्वारकाभुवम् ।
यादवानुपसंहृत्य यास्यामि त्रिदशालयम् ॥ २४ ॥
items.tr:
yathā gṛhītamaṃbhodherdattvāhaṃ dvārakābhuvam |
yādavānupasaṃhṛtya yāsyāmi tridaśālayam || 24 ||

items.text:
मनुष्यदेहमुत्सृज्य संकर्षणसहायवान् ।
प्राप्त एवास्मि मंतव्यो देवेंद्रे ण तथाऽमरैः ॥ २५ ॥
items.tr:
manuṣyadehamutsṛjya saṃkarṣaṇasahāyavān |
prāpta evāsmi maṃtavyo deveṃdre ṇa tathā'maraiḥ || 25 ||

items.text:
जरासंधादयो येऽन्ये निहता भारहेतवः ।
क्षितेस्तेभ्यःकुमारोऽपि यदूनां नापचीयते ॥ २६ ॥
items.tr:
jarāsaṃdhādayo ye'nye nihatā bhārahetavaḥ |
kṣitestebhyaḥkumāro'pi yadūnāṃ nāpacīyate || 26 ||

items.text:
तदेतं सुमहाभारमवतार्य क्षितेरहम् ।
यास्याम्यमरलोकस्य पालनाय ब्रवीहि तान् ॥ २७ ॥
items.tr:
tadetaṃ sumahābhāramavatārya kṣiteraham |
yāsyāmyamaralokasya pālanāya bravīhi tān || 27 ||

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
इत्युक्तो वासुदेवेन देवदूतः प्रणम्य तम् ।
मैत्रेय दिव्यया गत्या देवराजांतिकं ययौ ॥ २८ ॥
items.tr:
ityukto vāsudevena devadūtaḥ praṇamya tam |
maitreya divyayā gatyā devarājāṃtikaṃ yayau || 28 ||

items.text:
भगवानप्यथोत्पातान्दिव्यभौमांतरिक्षजान् ।
ददर्श द्वारकापुर्य्यां विनाशाय दिवानिशम् ॥ २९ ॥
items.tr:
bhagavānapyathotpātāndivyabhaumāṃtarikṣajān |
dadarśa dvārakāpuryyāṃ vināśāya divāniśam || 29 ||

items.text:
तान्दृष्ट्वा यादवानाह पश्यध्वमतिदारुणान् ।
महोत्पाताञ्छमायैषां प्रभासं याम मा चिरम् ॥ ३० ॥
items.tr:
tāndṛṣṭvā yādavānāha paśyadhvamatidāruṇān |
mahotpātāñchamāyaiṣāṃ prabhāsaṃ yāma mā ciram || 30 ||

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
एवमुक्ते तु कृष्णेन यादवप्रवरस्ततः ।
महाभागवतः प्राह प्रणिपत्योद्धवो हरिम् ॥ ३१ ॥
items.tr:
evamukte tu kṛṣṇena yādavapravarastataḥ |
mahābhāgavataḥ prāha praṇipatyoddhavo harim || 31 ||

items.text:
भगवन्यन्मया कार्यं तदाज्ञापय सांप्रतम् ।
मन्ये कुलमिदं सर्वं भगवान्संहरिष्यति ॥ ३२ ॥
items.tr:
bhagavanyanmayā kāryaṃ tadājñāpaya sāṃpratam |
manye kulamidaṃ sarvaṃ bhagavānsaṃhariṣyati || 32 ||

items.text: नाशायास्य निमित्तानि कुलस्याच्युत लक्षये ॥ ३३ ॥
items.tr: nāśāyāsya nimittāni kulasyācyuta lakṣaye || 33 ||

items.text:
गच्छ त्वं दिव्यया गत्या मत्प्रसादसमुत्थया ।
यद्बदर्याश्रमं पुण्यं गंधमादनपर्वते ।
नरनारायणस्थाने तत्पवित्रं महीतले ॥ ३४ ॥
items.tr:
gaccha tvaṃ divyayā gatyā matprasādasamutthayā |
yadbadaryāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ gaṃdhamādanaparvate |
naranārāyaṇasthāne tatpavitraṃ mahītale || 34 ||
items.speaker: श्रीभगवानुवाच

items.text:
मन्मना मत्प्रसादेन तत्र सिद्धिमवाप्स्यसि ।
अहं स्वर्गं गमिष्यामि ह्युपसंहृत्य वै कुलम् ॥ ३५ ॥
items.tr:
manmanā matprasādena tatra siddhimavāpsyasi |
ahaṃ svargaṃ gamiṣyāmi hyupasaṃhṛtya vai kulam || 35 ||

items.text:
द्वारकां च मया त्यक्तां समुद्र ः! प्लावयिष्यति ।
मद्वेश्म चैकं मुक्त्वा तु भयान्मत्तो जलाशये ।
तत्र सन्निहितश्चाहं भक्तानां हितकाम्यया ॥ ३६ ॥
items.tr:
dvārakāṃ ca mayā tyaktāṃ samudra ḥ! plāvayiṣyati |
madveśma caikaṃ muktvā tu bhayānmatto jalāśaye |
tatra sannihitaścāhaṃ bhaktānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 36 ||

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
इत्युक्तः प्रणिपत्यैनं जगामाशु तपोवनम् ।
नरनारायणस्थानं केशवेनानुमोदितः ॥ ३७ ॥
items.tr:
ityuktaḥ praṇipatyainaṃ jagāmāśu tapovanam |
naranārāyaṇasthānaṃ keśavenānumoditaḥ || 37 ||

items.text:
ततस्ते यादवास्सर्वे रथानारुह्य शीघ्रगान् ।
प्रभासं प्रययुस्सार्द्धं कृष्णरामादिभिर्द्विज ॥ ३८ ॥
items.tr:
tataste yādavāssarve rathānāruhya śīghragān |
prabhāsaṃ prayayussārddhaṃ kṛṣṇarāmādibhirdvija || 38 ||

items.text:
प्रभासं समनुप्राप्ताः कुकुरांधकवृष्णयः ।
चक्रुस्तत्र महापानं वासुदेवेन चोदिताः ॥ ३९ ॥
items.tr:
prabhāsaṃ samanuprāptāḥ kukurāṃdhakavṛṣṇayaḥ |
cakrustatra mahāpānaṃ vāsudevena coditāḥ || 39 ||

items.text:
पिबतां तत्र चैतेषां संघर्षेण परस्परम् ।
अतिवादेंधनो जज्ञे कलहाग्निः क्षयावहः ॥ ४० ॥
items.tr:
pibatāṃ tatra caiteṣāṃ saṃgharṣeṇa parasparam |
ativādeṃdhano jajñe kalahāgniḥ kṣayāvahaḥ || 40 ||

items.speaker: मैत्रेय उवाच
items.text:
स्वंस्वं वै भुंजतां तेषां कलहः किंनिमित्तकः ।
संघर्षो वा द्विजश्रेष्ठ तन्ममाख्यातुमर्हसि ॥ ४१ ॥
items.tr:
svaṃsvaṃ vai bhuṃjatāṃ teṣāṃ kalahaḥ kiṃnimittakaḥ |
saṃgharṣo vā dvijaśreṣṭha tanmamākhyātumarhasi || 41 ||

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
मृष्टं मदीयमन्नं ते न मृष्टमिति जल्पताम् ।
मृष्टामृष्टकथा जज्ञे संघर्षकलहौ ततः ॥ ४२ ॥
items.tr:
mṛṣṭaṃ madīyamannaṃ te na mṛṣṭamiti jalpatām |
mṛṣṭāmṛṣṭakathā jajñe saṃgharṣakalahau tataḥ || 42 ||

items.text:
ततश्चान्योन्यमभ्येत्य क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनाः ।
जघ्नुः परस्परं ते तु शस्त्रैर्दैवबलात्कृताः ॥ ४३ ॥
items.tr:
tataścānyonyamabhyetya krodhasaṃraktalocanāḥ |
jaghnuḥ parasparaṃ te tu śastrairdaivabalātkṛtāḥ || 43 ||

items.text: क्षीणशस्त्राश्च जगृहुः प्रत्यासन्नामथैरकाम् ॥ ४४ ॥
items.tr: kṣīṇaśastrāśca jagṛhuḥ pratyāsannāmathairakām || 44 ||

items.text:
एरका तु गृहीता वै वज्रभूतेव लक्ष्यते ।
तया परस्परं जघ्नुस्संप्रहारे सुदारुणे ॥ ४५ ॥
items.tr:
erakā tu gṛhītā vai vajrabhūteva lakṣyate |
tayā parasparaṃ jaghnussaṃprahāre sudāruṇe || 45 ||

items.text:
प्रद्युम्नसांबप्रमुखाः कृतवर्माथ सात्यकिः ।
अनिरुद्धादयश्चान्ये पृथुर्विपृथुरेव च ॥ ४६ ॥
items.tr:
pradyumnasāṃbapramukhāḥ kṛtavarmātha sātyakiḥ |
aniruddhādayaścānye pṛthurvipṛthureva ca || 46 ||

items.text:
चारुवर्मा चारुकश्च तथाक्रूरादयो द्विज ।
एरकारूपिभिर्वज्रैस्ते निजघ्नुः परस्परम् ॥ ४७ ॥
items.tr:
cāruvarmā cārukaśca tathākrūrādayo dvija |
erakārūpibhirvajraiste nijaghnuḥ parasparam || 47 ||

items.text:
निवारयामास हरिर्यादवांस्ते च केशवम् ।
सहायं मेनिरेरीणां प्राप्तं जघ्नुः परस्परम् ॥ ४८ ॥
items.tr:
nivārayāmāsa hariryādavāṃste ca keśavam |
sahāyaṃ menirerīṇāṃ prāptaṃ jaghnuḥ parasparam || 48 ||

items.text:
कृष्णोऽपि कुपितस्तेषामेरकामुष्टिमाददे ।
वधाय सोपि मुसलं मुष्टर्लौहमभूत्तदा ॥ ४९ ॥
items.tr:
kṛṣṇo'pi kupitasteṣāmerakāmuṣṭimādade |
vadhāya sopi musalaṃ muṣṭarlauhamabhūttadā || 49 ||

items.text:
जघान तेन निश्श्षोआ!न्यादवानाततायिनः ।
जघ्नुस्ते सहसाभ्येत्य तथाऽन्येपि परस्परम् ॥ ५० ॥
items.tr:
jaghāna tena niśśṣoā!nyādavānātatāyinaḥ |
jaghnuste sahasābhyetya tathā'nyepi parasparam || 50 ||

items.text:
ततश्चार्णवमध्येन जैत्रोऽसौ चक्रिणो रथः ।
पश्यतो दारुकस्याथ प्रायादश्वैर्धृतो द्विज ॥ ५१ ॥
items.tr:
tataścārṇavamadhyena jaitro'sau cakriṇo rathaḥ |
paśyato dārukasyātha prāyādaśvairdhṛto dvija || 51 ||

items.text:
चक्रं गदा तथा शार्ङ्गं तूणीशंखोसिरेव च ।
प्रदक्षिणं हरिं कृत्वा जग्मुरादित्यवर्त्त्मना ॥ ५२ ॥
items.tr:
cakraṃ gadā tathā śārṅgaṃ tūṇīśaṃkhosireva ca |
pradakṣiṇaṃ hariṃ kṛtvā jagmurādityavarttmanā || 52 ||

items.text:
क्षणेन नाभवत्कश्चिद्यादवानामघातितः ।
ऋते कृष्णं महात्मानं दारुकं च महामुने ॥ ५३ ॥
items.tr:
kṣaṇena nābhavatkaścidyādavānāmaghātitaḥ |
ṛte kṛṣṇaṃ mahātmānaṃ dārukaṃ ca mahāmune || 53 ||

items.text:
चंक्रम्यमाणौ तौ रामं वृक्षमूले कृतासनम् ।
ददृशाते मुखाच्चास्य निष्क्रामंतं महोरगम् ॥ ५४ ॥
items.tr:
caṃkramyamāṇau tau rāmaṃ vṛkṣamūle kṛtāsanam |
dadṛśāte mukhāccāsya niṣkrāmaṃtaṃ mahoragam || 54 ||

items.text:
निष्क्रम्य स मखात्तस्य महाभोगो भुजंगमः ।
प्रययावर्णवं सिद्धैः पूज्यमानस्तथोरगैः ॥ ५५ ॥
items.tr:
niṣkramya sa makhāttasya mahābhogo bhujaṃgamaḥ |
prayayāvarṇavaṃ siddhaiḥ pūjyamānastathoragaiḥ || 55 ||

items.text:
ततोर्घ्यमादाय तदा जलधिस्संमुखं ययौ ।
प्रविवेश ततस्तोयं पूजितः पन्नगोत्तमैः ॥ ५६ ॥
items.tr:
tatorghyamādāya tadā jaladhissaṃmukhaṃ yayau |
praviveśa tatastoyaṃ pūjitaḥ pannagottamaiḥ || 56 ||

items.text:
दृष्ट्वा बलस्य निर्याणं दारुकं प्राह केशवः ।
इदं सर्वं समाचक्ष्व वसुदेवोग्रसेनयोः ॥ ५७ ॥
items.tr:
dṛṣṭvā balasya niryāṇaṃ dārukaṃ prāha keśavaḥ |
idaṃ sarvaṃ samācakṣva vasudevograsenayoḥ || 57 ||

items.text:
निर्याणं बलभद्र स्य यादवानां तथा क्षयम् ।
योगे स्थित्वाहमप्येतत्परित्यक्ष्ये कलेवरम् ॥ ५८ ॥
items.tr:
niryāṇaṃ balabhadra sya yādavānāṃ tathā kṣayam |
yoge sthitvāhamapyetatparityakṣye kalevaram || 58 ||

items.text:
वाच्यश्च द्वारकावासी जनस्सर्वस्तथाहुकः ।
यथेमां नगरीं सर्वां समुद्र ः! प्लावयिष्यति ॥ ५९ ॥
items.tr:
vācyaśca dvārakāvāsī janassarvastathāhukaḥ |
yathemāṃ nagarīṃ sarvāṃ samudra ḥ! plāvayiṣyati || 59 ||

items.text:
तस्माद्भवद्भिस्सर्वैस्तु प्रतीक्ष्यो ह्यर्जुनागमः ।
न स्थेयं द्वारकामध्ये निष्क्रांते तत्र पांडवे ॥ ६० ॥
items.tr:
tasmādbhavadbhissarvaistu pratīkṣyo hyarjunāgamaḥ |
na stheyaṃ dvārakāmadhye niṣkrāṃte tatra pāṃḍave || 60 ||

items.text: तेनैव सह गंतव्यं यत्र याति स कौरवः ॥ ६१ ॥
items.tr: tenaiva saha gaṃtavyaṃ yatra yāti sa kauravaḥ || 61 ||

items.text:
गत्वा च ब्रूहि कौंतेयमर्जुनं वचनान्मम ।
पालनीयस्त्वया शक्त्या जनोऽयं मत्परिग्रहः ॥ ६२ ॥
items.tr:
gatvā ca brūhi kauṃteyamarjunaṃ vacanānmama |
pālanīyastvayā śaktyā jano'yaṃ matparigrahaḥ || 62 ||

items.text:
त्वमर्जुनेन सहितो द्वारवत्यां तथा जनम् ।
गृहीत्वा यादि वज्रश्च यदुराजो भविष्यति ॥ ६३ ॥
items.tr:
tvamarjunena sahito dvāravatyāṃ tathā janam |
gṛhītvā yādi vajraśca yadurājo bhaviṣyati || 63 ||

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
इत्युक्तो दारुकः कृष्णं प्रणिपत्य पुनःपुनः ।
प्रदक्षिणं च बहुशः कृत्वा प्रायाद्यथोदितम् ॥ ६४ ॥
items.tr:
ityukto dārukaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ praṇipatya punaḥpunaḥ |
pradakṣiṇaṃ ca bahuśaḥ kṛtvā prāyādyathoditam || 64 ||

items.text:
स च गत्वा तदाचष्ट द्वारकायां तथाऽर्जुनम् ।
आनिनाय महाबुद्धिर्वज्रं चक्रे तथा नृपम् ॥ ६५ ॥
items.tr:
sa ca gatvā tadācaṣṭa dvārakāyāṃ tathā'rjunam |
ānināya mahābuddhirvajraṃ cakre tathā nṛpam || 65 ||

items.text:
भगवानपि गोविंदो वासुदेवात्मकं परम् ।
ब्रह्मात्मनि समारोप्य सर्वभूतेष्वधारयत् ।
निष्प्रपंचे महाभाग संयोज्यात्मानमात्मनि ।
तुर्यावस्थसलीलं च श्तोए!स्म पुरुषोत्तमः ॥ ६६ ॥
items.tr:
bhagavānapi goviṃdo vāsudevātmakaṃ param |
brahmātmani samāropya sarvabhūteṣvadhārayat |
niṣprapaṃce mahābhāga saṃyojyātmānamātmani |
turyāvasthasalīlaṃ ca śtoe!sma puruṣottamaḥ || 66 ||

items.text:
संमानयन्द्विजवचो दुर्वासा यदुवाच ह ।
योगयुक्तोऽभवत्पादं कृत्वा जानुनि सत्तम ॥ ६७ ॥
items.tr:
saṃmānayandvijavaco durvāsā yaduvāca ha |
yogayukto'bhavatpādaṃ kṛtvā jānuni sattama || 67 ||

items.text:
आययौ स जरानाम तदा तत्र स लुब्धकः ।
मुसलावशेषलोहैकसायकन्यस्ततोमरः ॥ ६८ ॥
items.tr:
āyayau sa jarānāma tadā tatra sa lubdhakaḥ |
musalāvaśeṣalohaikasāyakanyastatomaraḥ || 68 ||

items.text:
स तत्पादं मृगाकारमवेक्ष्यारादवस्थितः ।
तले विव्याध तेनैव तोमरेण द्विजोत्तम ॥ ६९ ॥
items.tr:
sa tatpādaṃ mṛgākāramavekṣyārādavasthitaḥ |
tale vivyādha tenaiva tomareṇa dvijottama || 69 ||

items.text:
ततश्च ददृशो! तत्र चदुर्बाहुधरं नरम् ।
प्रणिपत्त्याह चैवैनं प्रसीदेति पुनःपुनः ॥ ७० ॥
items.tr:
tataśca dadṛśo! tatra cadurbāhudharaṃ naram |
praṇipattyāha caivainaṃ prasīdeti punaḥpunaḥ || 70 ||

items.text:
अजानता कृतमिदं मया हरिणशंकया ।
क्षम्यतां मम पापेन दग्धं मां त्रातुमर्हसि ॥ ७१ ॥
items.tr:
ajānatā kṛtamidaṃ mayā hariṇaśaṃkayā |
kṣamyatāṃ mama pāpena dagdhaṃ māṃ trātumarhasi || 71 ||

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
ततस्तं भगवानाह न तेस्तु भयमण्वपि ।
गच्छ त्वं मत्प्रसादेन लुब्ध स्वर्गं सुरास्पदम् ॥ ७२ ॥
items.tr:
tatastaṃ bhagavānāha na testu bhayamaṇvapi |
gaccha tvaṃ matprasādena lubdha svargaṃ surāspadam || 72 ||

items.speaker: श्रीपराशर उवाच
items.text:
विमानमागतं सद्यस्तद्वाक्यसमनंतरम् ।
आरुह्य प्रययौ स्वर्गं लुब्धकस्तत्प्रसादतः ॥ ७३ ॥
items.tr:
vimānamāgataṃ sadyastadvākyasamanaṃtaram |
āruhya prayayau svargaṃ lubdhakastatprasādataḥ || 73 ||

items.text:
गते तस्मिन्सभगवान्संयोज्यात्मानमात्मनि ।
ब्रह्मभूतेऽव्ययेचिंत्ये वासुदेवमयेऽमले ॥ ७४ ॥
items.tr:
gate tasminsabhagavānsaṃyojyātmānamātmani |
brahmabhūte'vyayeciṃtye vāsudevamaye'male || 74 ||

items.text:
अजन्मन्यमरे विष्णावप्रमेयेऽखिलात्मनि ।
तत्याज मानुषं देहमतीत्य त्रिविधां गतिम् ॥ ७५ ॥
items.tr:
ajanmanyamare viṣṇāvaprameye'khilātmani |
tatyāja mānuṣaṃ dehamatītya trividhāṃ gatim || 75 ||

en_chapter: In this way, Krishna, aided by Baladeva, destroyed, for the behoof of the earth, demons and iniquitous kings, and along with Phalguna also did he relieve earth of her burden by the death of seven Akshauhini hosts. Having thus relieved the earth of her load and destroyed many impious kings, he exterminated, by the plea of an imprecation denounced by Brāhmanas, his own Yādava race. Thereupon quitting Dwārakā and renouncing his mortal frame, the self-born with all his emanations re-entered his own sphere of Vishnu.
Maitreya said:—Tell me how Janārddana brought about the extermination of his own family under the pretext of a Brāminical curse and in what manner did he renounce his human body.

Parāçara said;—At the holy place of Pindarika, Viswāmitra, Kanwa and the great sage, Nārada, were seen by some boys of the Yadu family. Inflated with their youths and influenced by predestined results, they dressed and adorned Sāmba, the son of Jāmbavati, as a female and taking her to the sages, they addressed them with usual reverence, saying:—"What child will this female, the wife of Babru, who is anxious to have a son, give birth to?" The sages, who were gifted with divine wisdom, enraged at this insult, said:—"She will give birth to a club that will exterminate the entire Yādava race".

Thus addressed by the sages, the boys went to Ugrasena and related to him what had happened; and after sometime, as foretold, a club was produced from the belly of Sāmba. Ugrasena had the club, which was made of iron, ground to dust and thrown into the sea, and particles of the dust there became rushes, There was one part of the iron club which was like the blade of a lance and which the Andhakas could not break; this when thrown into the sea was swallowed by a fish; the fish was caught, the iron spike was extracted from its belly, and was taken by a hunter named Jāra. The all-wise and illustrious slayer of Madhu did not think it proper to counteract the predestination of fate.

In the interval an emissarry despatched by the celestials came to Krishna and said to him in private:—"I am sent to thee, O lord, by the celestials; and do thou hear what Indra together with the Viswas, Maruts, Adityas, Sādhyas and Rudras respectfully represent. More than a century has gone by since thou in compliance with the request of the celestials, descended upon earth for the purpose of relieving it of its load. The demons have been destroyed and the burden of earth has been removed; now let the immortals once again see their king in heaven. More than a hundred years have passed, and if thou dost wish, do thou return to heaven. This is the prayer of the celestials. And if this be not thy will, do thou remain here as long as it may be desirable to thy dependants". Whereto Krishna replied, "I am well aware of all thou hast said. The earth is not relieved of her load until the Yādavas are extirpated. I shall also speedily bring it about in my descent, and it shall take place in seven nights. Having restored the land of Dwārakā to the ocean and destroyed the race of Yadu, I shall proceed to the region of the celestials. Inform the celestials that having renounced my mortal frame and been accompanied by Sankarshana, I will then return to them. The tyrants that oppressed the earth, Jarāsandha and the rest, have been slain and a youth even of the race of Yadu is so less than they an incumbrance. Having removed this huge weight of the earth, I will proceed to the mansions of the celestials. Say this to them".

Parāçara said:—O Maitreya, being thus addressed by Vāsudeva, the messenger of the celestials bowed and took his heavenly course to the king of the deities. The illustrious Krishna too now espied signs and portents both on earth and in heaven prognosticating day and night the destruction of Dwārakā. Beholding those evil omens, he said to the Yādavas; "Behold these dreadful portents; let us hasten to Prabhāsa to avert them". When he had thus said to the eminent Yādavas, the illustrious Uddhava saluted and said to him: "Tell me, O lord, what it is proper that I should do, for it seems to me that thou wilt destroy all this race. The signs that are manifest declare nothing less than the annihilation of the race". Then Krishna replied:—"Do thou, by my favour proceed, this celestial course, to the holy place Badrikāsrama in the Gandhamādana mountain, the shrine of Nara Nārāyana; and on that spot sanctified by them, thou, meditating upon me, shalt obtain perfection through my favour. Having extirpated this Yadu race, I shall proceed to Baikuntha; and after I have quilted Dwārakā; the ocean shall inundate it".

Parāçara said:—Being thus addressed by him and commanded by Kesava, Uddhava proceeded to the holy shrine of Nara Nārāyana. And the Yādavas, with Krishna, Balarāma and others, having ascended swift-coursing cars, proceeded to Prabhāsa. Having reached Prabhāsa, the Kukkuras and Andhakas bathed there and, being excited by Krishna, indulged in liquor. As they drank, the destructive fire of dissension was engendered amongst them by mutual collision and fed with the fuel of abuse. Worked up with ire by the divine influence, they attacked one another with missile weapons, and when these were finished, they had recourse to the rushes growing nigh. The rushes in their hands became like thunder-bolts, and they assailed one another with them. Pradyumna, Syāmba, Kritavarman, Satyaki, Aniruddha, Prithu, Vipathu, Charuvannan, Charuka, Akrura, and many others, struck one another with the rushes, which became hard like thunder-bolts. Thereupon Krishna arriving there prevented them: but they thought that he was taking part with each severally and continued the conflict.

Thereupon, enraged, Krishna took up a handful of rushes to destroy them, which became a club of iron; and with this he killed many of the murderous Yādavas, whilst others fighting fiercely destroyed one another. At this time in the very presence of Krishna's charioteer, his swift steeds carried off his Jaitra car and entered into the sea. The discus, the club, the bow, the quiver, the shell and the sword of Kesava, having circumambulated their master, flew along the path of the sun. In a short time there was not a single Yādava left alive save the mighty Krishna and Dāruka. Going towards Rāma, who was sitting at the root of a tree, they saw a huge serpent coming out of his mouth. Having issued out of his mouth, the mighty snake proceeded towards the ocean hymned by saints and other great snakes. Bringing an offering of respect, the ocean came to him and then the majestic being worshipped of all the attendant snakes, entered into the waters of the deep. Beholding the departure of the spirit of Baladeva, Kesava said to Dāruka—"Do thou go to Vasudeva and Ugrasena and communicate unto him this. Go and inform them of the departure of Balabhadra, and the destruction of the Yādava race, and also that I shall engage in religious meditation and renounce my body. Do thou also inform Ahuka and the inhabitants of Dwārakā that their city shall be inundated by the ocean. And do ye await the arrival of Arjuna at Dwārakā. When Arjuna, the descendant of Pāndu, shall issue out of the city, none of you should wait there but go whither the descendant of Kuru shall repair. Do thou also go to the son of Kunti and tell him that he may at my request protect my family according to his might. Then go to Hastināpur with Arjuna and all the inhabitants of Dwārakā and let Vajra be installed king over the race of Yadu".

Parāçara said:—Thus instructed and having bowed unto and circumambulated Krishna again and again, Dāruka departed as he had been desired; and having conducted Arjuna to Dwārāvati, the intelligent servant of Krishna established Vajra as king. Thereupon having concentrated in himself that supreme spirit which is identical with Vāsudeva, the divine Govinda was identified with all beings. Respecting the words of the Brāhmana, the curse of Durvāsas, the illustrious Krishna sat engaged in meditation, placing his foot upon his knee. Then there came a hunter named Jāra, whose arrow was tipped with a blade made of the iron club, which had not been reduced to powder; and espying from a distance the foot of Krishna, he mistook it for a part of a deer, and shooting his arrow, lodged it in the sole. Approaching his mark, he saw the four-armed king and falling at his feet, repeatedly besought his forgiveness, exclaming, "I have done this deed unknowingly, thinking I was aiming at a deer. Have pity on me who am consumed by my crime; for thou art able to consume me". Thereupon Bhagavān said: "Thou needst not have the least fear, hunter; by my favour, thou shall repair to the region of the celestials". As soon as Krishna had said this, the celestial car arrived there, ascending which the hunter repaired to the region of the celestials.

Thereupon the divine Krishna having united himself with his own pure, spiritual, inexhaustible, inconceivable, unborn, undecaying, imperishable, and universal spirit, which is one Vāsudeva, renounced his mortal frame and his connection with the three qualities.
en_chapter_note: This passage also covers chapter 38 (the printed text has no break between them).
